scenario_description:
Objective: Use an optional no-cost CSV cleanup mini-lab to make the Maple Towers callback spreadsheet easier to reconcile.
Emerging Need: The seat opening first appears during a conflicting volunteer obligation and before a relevant record-cleanup task is evident; later the conflict clears and duplicate signup rows make the training useful.
Decision Context: A stored training note supplies the Waste Wise request code, eligibility constraint, subject wording, and no-conflict condition needed to judge a proportionate seat request.
Consequence: Timely registration could improve the Friday May 22 handoff, after the Wednesday May 20 lab without changing baseline paper records; once the roster is printed, the cleanup proceeds normally without the lab benefit.

parameter.title: Reuse Center shelf inventory count
parameter.description: Volunteer shelf count for reusable outreach supplies before afternoon tote checks.

parameter.subject: Open volunteer seats: CSV cleanup mini-lab May 20
parameter.body: Two no-cost observer seats are available for the Wednesday 10:00-11:00 CSV cleanup mini-lab in the Public Works training room. Waitlist requests are accepted until Monday, May 18 at 14:00; after that the room roster is printed. The exercises use generic sample data and are optional.

parameter.title: Reuse Center shelf inventory count
parameter.description: Covered by Reuse Center staff; volunteer shelf count removed from Oona's schedule.

parameter.content: Maple Towers signup sheets have several duplicate apartment and unit rows. The callback spreadsheet handoff is Friday, May 22 at 16:00, after Wednesday's mini-lab. The paper list is usable, so no early cleanup is required; this is the current volunteer record-cleanup task for the coming week.

parameter.subject: CSV mini-lab roster printed
parameter.body: The Wednesday CSV cleanup mini-lab roster has been printed, and late additions cannot be accepted for this room setup. We may run another volunteer session in the summer if interest continues.
